discrepancy_notes: Count: Gemini notes claim 12 items; transcript evidence supports 16 recorded items. The 12 reconcile exactly only under the consolidations described in reconciliation_summary (Drazen's ~14 discovery-demand commitments collapsed into DZ-01; FR-08 completed during the call; FR-09 unclear referent; DZ-04 and FAM-01 treated as non-work items).
Faraaz count: 7 matches only if the completed poster send (FR-08) and the unclear '100 million with a base of 10' check (FR-09) are excluded; including them the transcript shows 9 Faraaz-owned items.

Drazen count: 3 matches only at the consolidated level; at the individual-demand level the transcript records ~14 distinct discovery commitments plus the malicious-prosecution review and mediation sequencing.
No stated deadline exists for any item except the November 2026 mediation completion (DZ-03) and Drazen's unspecified draft deadline (DZ-01: 'There is no set time. I mean, there's a deadline').
FR-09's referent ('a document for 100 million with a base of 10') was never clarified on the record — possibly a damages/valuation figure; flagged in damages_mentions.json as well.
